markup: <Button Content="Confirm"><Button.Resources><TimbreClip Name="ConfirmTimbre">@parameter ToneCutoff: float = 1200; @parameter EchoMix: float = 0.15; @sound Confirm { Source = "audio/confirm.wav"; Volume = 0.8; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = ToneCutoff; } @modifier Delay { Time = 120ms; Feedback = 0.20; Mix = EchoMix; } }</TimbreClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@timbre $ConfirmTimbre(ToneCutoff = 800); @on Click { @play $self.timbre.Confirm; @animate with Tween(300ms, EaseOut) { @to { $self.timbre.Confirm.Volume = 0.8; $self.timbre.Confirm.ToneCutoff = 6000; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

<Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><TimbreClip Name="Sounds">@parameter Cut: float = 900; @sound Tone { Source = "audio/tone.wav"; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; } } @sound Plain { Source = "audio/plain.wav"; }</TimbreClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@timbre $Sounds; @on Click { @play $self.timbre.Plain; @animate with Spring(520, 38, 1) { @from { $self.timbre.Plain.Volume = 0; } @to { $self.timbre.Plain.Volume = 1; } } } @on MouseEnter { @animate { @to { $self.timbre.Plain.Volume = current; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

<Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><TimbreClip Name="Wash">@parameter Amount: float = 0.3; @sound Wash { Source = "audio/wash.wav"; @modifier Delay { Feedback = Amount; Mix = Amount; } }</TimbreClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@timbre $Wash; @on Click { @play $self.timbre.Wash; @animate { @to { $self.timbre.Wash.Amount = 0.9; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

<Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><TimbreClip Name="Sounds">@parameter Cut: float = 900; @sound Tone { Source = "audio/tone.wav"; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; } } @sound Plain { Source = "audio/plain.wav"; }</TimbreClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@timbre $Sounds; @on Click { @play $self.timbre.Tone; @sequence { @keyframes duration 400ms { @animate 0%..100% { @from { $self.timbre.Tone.Volume = 0; } @to { $self.timbre.Tone.Volume = 1; } } } @animate { @to { $self.timbre.Tone.Cut = 200; } } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

<Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><TimbreClip Name="Sounds">@parameter Cut: float = 900; @sound Tone { Source = "audio/tone.wav"; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; } } @sound Plain { Source = "audio/plain.wav"; }</TimbreClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@timbre $Sounds; @when $self.Opacity { @if value > 0.5 { @play $self.timbre.Tone; @animate { @to { $self.timbre.Tone.Volume = 0.3; } } } @if value < 0.5 { @animate { @to { $self.timbre.Tone.Volume = 0; } } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

note: The animated sound may have been started by AutoPlay; no @play in the same Aspect is needed.
markup: <Border><Border.Aspect>@timbre { @sound Music { Source = "audio/music.ogg"; Loop = true; AutoPlay = true; } } @on MouseEnter { @animate { @to { $self.timbre.Music.Volume = 0.2; } } }</Border.Aspect></Border>

<StackPanel><Border Name="Speaker"><Border.Aspect>@timbre { @sound Music { Source = "audio/music.ogg"; Loop = true; AutoPlay = true; } }</Border.Aspect></Border><Button Content="Quiet"><Button.Aspect>@on Click { @animate with Tween(500ms, Linear) { @to { $Speaker.timbre.Music.Volume = 0.1; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button></StackPanel>

<Button Content="x"><Button.Resources><TimbreClip Name="Sounds">@parameter Cut: float = 900; @sound Tone { Source = "audio/tone.wav"; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Cut; } } @sound Plain { Source = "audio/plain.wav"; }</TimbreClip></Button.Resources><Button.Aspect>@timbre $Sounds; @on Click { @animate { @to { $self.timbre.Missing.Volume = 0.3; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

expect.message: '$self' has no sound 'Missing' in its Aspect.
